CREATE TYPE do_mood AS ENUM('ok'); CREATE TABLE do_source(v int); INSERT INTO do_source VALUES(1); SET standard_conforming_strings=off

DO $$DECLARE i int; BEGIN FOR i IN 1..3 LOOP BEGIN RAISE NOTICE '%', (SELECT 'ok'::do_mood::text || 'a\nb' FROM do_source LIMIT 1); EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation THEN RAISE NOTICE '%', SQLSTATE; END; IF i=1 THEN ALTER TYPE do_mood RENAME VALUE 'ok' TO 'fine'; PERFORM set_config('standard_conforming_strings','on',false); ELSIF i=2 THEN ALTER TABLE do_source ADD COLUMN extra int; END IF; END LOOP; END$$
